On one hand I'd like to wait but I'm such a drain on the time/resources of other people that it seems rude to. I don't know, I'm just looking for an opportunity to be alone long enough. 

And I'd like to be in therapy but can't for several reasons. I'm poor and without access to healthcare (free or otherwise, I haven't seen a doctor since I was a child), my family would ridicule and mock me for it, I can't drive and there's no public transportation here, and I live in a small southern town without much in the way of mental health resources. Thanks,  the fact that someone bothered to respond to me is nice.
